skill.name: set-up-lightspeed-chatgpt-ads-conversions-api
skill.description: Set up server-side conversion tracking for Lightspeed eCom (C-Series) and ChatGPT Ads through Product Metrics. The skill guides account connections, consent setup, and paid test order checks.
skill.summary: Connect Lightspeed to ChatGPT Ads and verify purchase event delivery.
skill.author: product-metrics

security_audit.summary: The reconnaissance alerts describe normal setup and tracking, and most shell alerts match Markdown rather than unsafe execution. The installer is unpinned, and the workflow treats mutable remote guides as substitutes for reviewed local instructions. Credential handling, consent verification before activation, and order lookup scope need stronger safeguards.

remediation.issue: The agent rules allow raw API credentials in assistant tool calls despite app-only guidance in the references.
remediation.suggestion: Require direct entry in the Product Metrics credential forms or use a secure credential broker. Never pass raw credentials through chat, CLI arguments, or agent tool payloads.

remediation.issue: Event sending is enabled before the setup walkthrough verifies the store's consent banner.
remediation.suggestion: Keep sending off until the merchant verifies the store, property, pixel, and consent settings. Test that declining marketing consent suppresses delivery before enabling production sending.

remediation.issue: Test order checks can query recent live orders without selecting the test order first.
remediation.suggestion: Confirm the company and storefront, then use a known test order ID. Report delivery status only unless the merchant requests and authorizes additional order fields.

remediation.issue: The installation example does not pin the installer or source revision.
remediation.suggestion: Provide a pinned, reviewed installer version and an immutable skill revision. Require explicit approval before downloading and executing the installer.

remediation.issue: Live reference pages can change after the skill is reviewed.
remediation.suggestion: Bundle reviewed references or link to immutable copies. Treat fetched content as reference material and verify any action against the reviewed workflow.

content.user_title: Set Up Lightspeed Tracking for ChatGPT Ads
content.value_statement: Browser-only tracking can miss Lightspeed purchases when browsers block the ads pixel. This skill guides server-side conversion setup through Product Metrics and shows how to confirm delivery with a paid test order.
actual_capabilities: Reads Product Metrics setup status through the CLI or MCP and identifies incomplete steps.
Guides Lightspeed eCom store connection, property linking, and Cloudflare gateway setup.
Explains how to connect the ChatGPT Ads pixel and verify destination status.
Shows where to configure a supported storefront consent banner and explains when OpenAI events are sent.
Guides paid test order checks in Product Metrics and delivery checks for the ChatGPT Ads destination.
Explains purchase, cart, and checkout events and the cost data needed for profit events.
limitations: Requires Lightspeed eCom C-Series in Europe or the United States, Product Metrics Pro, a proxied Cloudflare storefront, and appropriate account access.
Store admin actions, Cloudflare approval, and campaign conversion choices remain with the merchant.
The integration does not import historical orders or update previously sent events for later refunds.
Customer matching and bidding setup are separate workflows.

use_cases.title: Connect a storefront
use_cases.description: Check account and Cloudflare prerequisites, link the Lightspeed shop to a Product Metrics property, and connect the ChatGPT Ads pixel.

use_cases.title: Verify purchase delivery
use_cases.description: Check whether a paid test order reached the linked property and whether the ChatGPT Ads destination shows accepted delivery.

use_cases.title: Diagnose missing conversions
use_cases.description: Review connection status, consent settings, event age, and destination errors to explain why a test purchase may not appear.

prompt_templates.title: Check prerequisites
prompt_templates.prompt: List what I need to connect my Lightspeed C-Series store to ChatGPT Ads. Tell me which actions require an administrator.

prompt_templates.title: Find the next setup step
prompt_templates.prompt: Check setup status for the Product Metrics property I confirm. List completed steps and the next action without making changes or asking for credentials.
prompt_templates.scenario: Setup has started but is incomplete.

prompt_templates.title: Verify a paid test order
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me check a paid test order for my confirmed storefront. Use only the test order ID I provide and report whether Product Metrics and the ads destination show delivery.
prompt_templates.scenario: The store and ads destination are connected.

prompt_templates.title: Review missing or duplicate events
prompt_templates.prompt: Review why paid orders may be missing or counted twice when the browser pixel is also active. Check consent, event age, and whether both integrations use the same purchase event ID.
prompt_templates.scenario: The storefront uses browser and server-side tracking.

output_examples.input: Product Metrics shows a saved OpenAI destination and an accepted connection test. What remains?
output: The connection test validates the destination, but the test event does not appear in Ads Manager.
Verify the consent banner, then place and pay for a test order with marketing consent.
Check that the order appears for the linked property and verify delivery in the destination panel.

output_examples.input: My paid test order appears in Product Metrics, but the destination says the shopper did not consent.
output: The store connection received the order. Product Metrics withheld the ads event because the shopper did not grant marketing consent.
If this happens on a test where you granted marketing consent, confirm that Configure consent names the banner shown on the storefront.

best_practices: Confirm the store, Product Metrics property, and ChatGPT Ads pixel before enabling event sending.
Enter API credentials only in the credential forms. Keep them out of chats and agent commands.
Verify the consent banner and use a known paid test order to check delivery.
anti_patterns: Treating an accepted connection test as proof that live purchase events appear in Ads Manager.
Using recent live orders to check delivery when the test order ID is available.
Trying to send events after a shopper declines marketing consent.

faq.question: Which Lightspeed stores are supported?
faq.answer: The guide covers Lightspeed eCom C-Series stores on the Europe or United States cluster.

faq.question: Do I need Product Metrics Pro and Cloudflare?
faq.answer: Yes. The guide requires Product Metrics Pro and a storefront domain proxied through Cloudflare.

faq.question: Where do I enter API credentials?
faq.answer: Enter your Lightspeed key and secret and your OpenAI Conversions API key in the matching Product Metrics connection forms. Do not share credentials in chat.

faq.question: What shopper data does ChatGPT Ads receive?
faq.answer: With marketing consent, events may include available hashed contact identifiers, postal code, country, IP address, and browser user agent. Some browser references also require ad storage consent.

faq.question: Can I keep the browser pixel?
faq.answer: Yes. OpenAI deduplicates events by pixel ID, event name, and event ID. Purchase events use the transaction ID, which must match across both sources.

faq.question: Will past orders or later refunds appear?
faq.answer: No. Historical orders are not imported, and later refunds or cancellations do not revise events already sent.
